title: Yeh Chhota Mic Speaker Ka Ulta Kaam Karta Hai 🎤 #shorts
description:
Ek taali aur bulb on! Magnet aur coil se awaaz kaise banti hai, aur sound sensor use wapas bijli mein kaise badalta hai?
🎤 KY-038 sound sensor ka 3D model
🧲 Speaker mein magnet aur coil ka kaam
🔬 Electret mic ke andar diaphragm aur backplate
⚡ LM393 comparator aur blue pot ka threshold
🔌 Arduino se wiring aur clap switch
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karo.
#shorts #arduino #sound #microphone #electronics #hindi
